rules.title: Argument format
rules.description: A command argument must match the expected naming format.
rules.agent_guidance: Check the command usage and retry with the expected identifier format.

rules.title: Required directory exists
rules.description: A required repository directory must exist.
rules.agent_guidance: Create the missing directory or update the standard if the directory is no longer required.

rules.title: Required file exists
rules.description: A required repository file must exist.
rules.agent_guidance: Create the missing file, restore it, or update the standard if the file is no longer required.

rules.title: Required artifact or field
rules.description: A required artifact, section, or field is missing.
rules.agent_guidance: Inspect the referenced artifact and add the missing required structure.

rules.title: Required text reference
rules.description: A text artifact must include a required reference.
rules.agent_guidance: Update the referenced artifact so it includes the required standard pointer.

rules.title: JSON parses
rules.description: A JSON schema or output file must parse as JSON.
rules.agent_guidance: Fix JSON syntax before making semantic changes.

rules.title: Schema URI declared
rules.description: A JSON Schema file must declare `$schema`.
rules.agent_guidance: Add the JSON Schema draft URI to the schema file.

rules.title: Schema ID declared
rules.description: A JSON Schema file must declare `$id`.
rules.agent_guidance: Add a stable schema ID to the schema file.

rules.title: Schema title
rules.description: A JSON Schema file must declare the expected title.
rules.agent_guidance: Update the schema title or the check expectation so they match intentionally.

rules.title: Required field declared
rules.description: A manifest, spec, or schema must declare a required field.
rules.agent_guidance: Add the missing field with a valid value according to the relevant standard.

rules.title: Required field group exists
rules.description: A manifest or spec must contain a required field group.
rules.agent_guidance: Add the missing group and keep its structure aligned with the source standard.

rules.title: Minimum artifact count
rules.description: A repository artifact collection must contain at least the expected number of items.
rules.agent_guidance: Create the missing artifact or update the standard if the collection is no longer required.

rules.title: Required Markdown section
rules.description: A Markdown document must include a required section.
rules.agent_guidance: Add the missing section and preserve the expected heading text.

rules.title: Required Markdown heading
rules.description: A Markdown document must include the expected top-level heading.
rules.agent_guidance: Update the document heading so it matches the standard for that artifact type.

rules.title: Required Markdown metadata
rules.description: A Markdown document must include required metadata fields.
rules.agent_guidance: Add the missing metadata field near the top of the document.

rules.title: Unique Markdown identifier
rules.description: A numbered Markdown record such as an ADR must use a repository-unique identifier.
rules.agent_guidance: Rename the duplicate record to the next available identifier and update its heading and references.

rules.title: Module registry match
rules.description: A module manifest must match the module registry entry.
rules.agent_guidance: Align `.arch/modules.yaml` and `modules/<module>/module.yaml`.

rules.title: Contract registry declared
rules.description: The contract registry must exist and declare the expected source format and decision.
rules.agent_guidance: Inspect `.arch/contracts.yaml` and align it with the contract source format decision.

rules.title: Contract registry entry
rules.description: A registered module contract entry must declare an id and source path in the expected location.
rules.agent_guidance: Update `.arch/contracts.yaml` so each command, query, event, error catalog, and permission catalog has a valid entry.

rules.title: Boundary-only contract module
rules.description: A registered module may intentionally have no public command, query, event, error, or permission contracts while it is only an ownership boundary.
rules.agent_guidance: Do not invent contracts just to satisfy checks. Ratify the public API first, then add contract source files and registry entries.

rules.title: Contract source exists
rules.description: A registered contract source file must exist.
rules.agent_guidance: Create the missing contract source file or update the registry path.

rules.title: Contract source field
rules.description: A contract source file must declare required fields such as schema_version and status.
rules.agent_guidance: Open the contract source file and add the missing required field.

rules.title: Contract source match
rules.description: A contract source file must match the registry and module manifest declarations.
rules.agent_guidance: Align the contract source, `.arch/contracts.yaml`, and `modules/<module>/module.yaml`.

rules.title: Protocol source root
rules.description: The Protobuf source root and expected module-level source paths must exist when required by the protocol alignment status.
rules.agent_guidance: Inspect `proto/`, `.arch/contracts.yaml`, and `.arch/runtime.yaml`; create the expected source directory or make the alignment status explicit before adding Protobuf files.

rules.title: Protocol framework manifest
rules.description: The game protocol framework manifest must exist and declare the accepted WebSocket Protobuf envelope, routing, session, target, authority, and compatibility model.
rules.agent_guidance: Inspect `.arch/protocol.yaml`, `docs/game-protocol.md`, and ADR-0015 before adding or changing protocol files.

rules.title: Planned missing Protobuf source
rules.description: A registered contract has a planned Protobuf source or message, but missing `.proto` files are still allowed by the current alignment status.
rules.agent_guidance: Treat this as a planning signal. Before creating `.proto` files, run `node tools/vibit check protocol` and keep the new source aligned with the reported expected path and messages.

rules.title: Protocol package
rules.description: A Protobuf source file must declare the expected package for its owning module and version.
rules.agent_guidance: Use package `vibit.<module>.v1` for `proto/vibit/<module>/v1/<module>.proto` unless a later protocol ADR changes the layout.

rules.title: Protocol message
rules.description: A Protobuf source file must declare the expected wire messages for registered commands, queries, and events.
rules.agent_guidance: Add or correct messages generated from registered contract IDs, such as `<Command>Request`, `<Command>Response`, `<Query>Request`, `<Query>Response`, and event names.

rules.title: Protocol enum value
rules.description: A Protobuf enum must declare the expected values for protocol message kinds, target scopes, or other compatibility-sensitive protocol concepts.
rules.agent_guidance: Compare the enum with `.arch/protocol.yaml` and the governing ADR before adding, removing, or renumbering values.

rules.title: Protocol field
rules.description: A Protobuf source file must expose fields matching the registered semantic contract payload, input, and output property names.
rules.agent_guidance: Compare the failing field with the corresponding file under `contracts/<module>/` and update the Protobuf source or contract intentionally.

rules.title: Protocol source trace
rules.description: A Protobuf source file must include trace metadata pointing back to the semantic contract sources it represents.
rules.agent_guidance: Add a source trace comment that references the relevant `contracts/` path or an `@source` marker before generated output is created.

rules.title: Protocol Buf configuration
rules.description: Buf configuration must declare the Protobuf source root, lint policy, breaking-change policy, Go generation plugin, output path, and source-relative generation mode.
rules.agent_guidance: Inspect `buf.yaml`, `buf.gen.yaml`, ADR-0013, and ADR-0016 before changing Protobuf generation configuration.

rules.title: Protocol envelope
rules.description: The protocol envelope Protobuf source must exist and declare the expected envelope, target, session, and error message shape.
rules.agent_guidance: Keep `proto/vibit/protocol/v1/envelope.proto` aligned with `.arch/protocol.yaml`, `docs/game-protocol.md`, and the accepted envelope ADR.

rules.title: Protocol Go package
rules.description: A Protobuf source file must declare the expected Go package option for generated Go output.
rules.agent_guidance: Align `option go_package` with the runtime generated output path and ADR-0014 before running Protobuf generation.

rules.title: Generated output declared
rules.description: A module manifest must declare generated files and directories that belong to the module.
rules.agent_guidance: Update `modules/<module>/module.yaml` so generated outputs are explicit.

rules.title: Generated output exists
rules.description: A generated file declared by a module manifest must exist on disk.
rules.agent_guidance: Run the generator or update the module manifest declaration.

rules.title: Generated output root
rules.description: A generated output root must exist and contain only allowed placeholder or generated files for its current phase.
rules.agent_guidance: Inspect the generated output standard and keep handwritten runtime code outside generated roots.

rules.title: Generated file shape
rules.description: A generated file must use the expected suffix and file shape for its generator and output root.
rules.agent_guidance: Regenerate the file with the accepted generator or move handwritten code out of the generated output root.

rules.title: Generated output trace
rules.description: A generated file must include trace metadata for its source and generator.
rules.agent_guidance: Regenerate the file or update the generator so it emits generated, source, and generator markers.

rules.title: Generated source trace
rules.description: A generated file must trace back to an existing source artifact.
rules.agent_guidance: Fix the source trace by regenerating from an existing source file; do not hand-edit generated output to mask drift.

rules.title: Handwritten generated-root code forbidden
rules.description: Handwritten runtime code is forbidden under generated output roots.
rules.agent_guidance: Move handwritten code to the correct runtime package and keep generated roots reserved for generated output.

rules.title: Generated contract shape
rules.description: Each registered generated-shape semantic contract, including runtime authentication, must have an inspectable generated Go contract shape.
rules.agent_guidance: Run `node tools/vibit generate contract-shapes all` and then `node tools/vibit check generated --json`.

rules.title: Generated output drift
rules.description: Generated output must match the current generator output for its source artifact.
rules.agent_guidance: Regenerate the artifact from source; do not hand-edit generated output.

rules.title: Migration source root
rules.description: PostgreSQL migration sources must live under the accepted runtime migration root.
rules.agent_guidance: Use `runtime/migrations/postgres/` for SQL-first PostgreSQL migration sources unless a superseding decision changes the layout.

rules.title: Migration file shape
rules.description: PostgreSQL SQL migration files must use deterministic sequence names and the accepted `.sql` shape.
rules.agent_guidance: Rename the migration to the `000001_name.sql` pattern or update the migration standard intentionally.

rules.title: Migration goose marker
rules.description: SQL migrations must declare both goose Up and Down sections.
rules.agent_guidance: Add `-- +goose Up` and `-- +goose Down` sections before treating the migration as reviewable source.

rules.title: Migration source trace
rules.description: Architecture manifests, standards, and module guidance must point to the accepted migration source root and first migration.
rules.agent_guidance: Update `.arch/runtime.yaml`, `.arch/conventions.yaml`, persistence docs, and module/runtime guides so future agents can find migration ownership.

rules.title: Migration ownership
rules.description: A migration that creates module-owned state must declare ownership and reference the expected module-owned tables.
rules.agent_guidance: Add an owning module trace comment and align created tables with the relevant module manifest and persistence boundary.

rules.title: Go migration forbidden by default
rules.description: Go migrations are forbidden unless a change spec explicitly explains why SQL is insufficient.
rules.agent_guidance: Prefer SQL migrations. If a Go migration is truly required, create a change spec and decision record before adding it.

rules.title: PostgreSQL verification environment standard
rules.description: The disposable PostgreSQL verification environment standard, manifests, and guidance artifacts must declare opt-in live database verification rules.
rules.agent_guidance: Update `docs/postgresql-verification-environment.md`, its translation, and the related manifests or guides so agents can distinguish source checks from optional live PostgreSQL verification.

rules.title: Runtime implementation not started
rules.description: The server runtime check may pass as not applicable before the Go runtime exists.
rules.agent_guidance: Do not create runtime code only to satisfy this check; add Go runtime verification when implementation begins.

rules.title: Runtime Go module
rules.description: The Go runtime module file must exist at the ADR-0014 path and declare the accepted module path.
rules.agent_guidance: Use `runtime/go.mod` with module path `github.com/iceiko/vibit/runtime` unless a superseding ADR changes the runtime layout.

rules.title: Runtime skeleton
rules.description: The Go runtime skeleton must include the package boundary roots declared by ADR-0014.
rules.agent_guidance: Create missing runtime or proto skeleton directories before adding runtime implementation code.

rules.title: Runtime protocol adapter boundary
rules.description: Runtime manifests, guides, and standards must declare the boundary between WebSocket transport, Protobuf protocol adaptation, application dispatch, generated code, and domain modules.
rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/runtime-protocol-adapter.md` and align `.arch/runtime.yaml`, `.arch/protocol.yaml`, runtime guides, and implementation code with the declared handoff.

rules.title: Runtime import boundary
rules.description: Runtime Go imports for WebSocket, Protobuf, PostgreSQL, migration tooling, and generated Protobuf packages must stay inside their declared owner packages.
rules.agent_guidance: Move the import behind the appropriate platform adapter or generated package boundary instead of importing foundational dependencies directly from domain or application code.

rules.title: Metadata-only identity boundary
rules.description: The metadata-only player/session boundary must prevent WebSocket transport, domain modules, and player artifacts from implicitly implementing authentication, tokens, credentials, sessions, unratified player persistence, or cross-module shortcuts.
rules.agent_guidance: Keep client-supplied identity metadata unauthenticated until a ratified session validation design exists; keep player account PostgreSQL schema limited to ratified lifecycle tables; move protocol, transport, auth, token, credential, session, and runtime handler behavior behind the declared owner boundary before implementation.

rules.title: Authentication, token, and session boundary
rules.description: The authentication/token/session design boundary must preserve metadata-only identity as unauthenticated and prevent tokens, credentials, external identity links, session persistence, WebSocket handshake auth, Protobuf envelope auth fields, and player routes from appearing before ratification.
rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/authentication-token-session-validation.md` and `ADR-0023`; update standards, manifests, contracts, and checks before adding authentication runtime code, token parsing, credential lookup, external identity linking, session persistence, Protobuf envelope changes, WebSocket handshake authentication, runtime player handlers, or WebSocket routes.

rules.title: Selected login and token boundary
rules.description: The selected device-credential login and opaque access-token posture must remain contract-only until schema, repository, adapter, test, generated output, protocol, and runtime implementation gates explicitly authorize concrete behavior.
rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/selected-login-token-boundary-checks.md`, `docs/credential-token-session-schema-gates.md`, and `ADR-0030`; generated authentication shapes are allowed only as source-traced metadata under `runtime/internal/generated/contracts/runtime/authentication/`. Do not add login handlers, token validators, token or credential repositories, authentication Protobuf sources, migrations, WebSocket carriers, or auth dependencies until a later bounded implementation work item authorizes them.

rules.title: Runtime authentication implementation boundary
rules.description: The first runtime authentication implementation path must preserve application ownership, storage-neutral repository usage, persistence-only PostgreSQL adapters, request identity handoff, and separate gates for token generation, verifier comparison, login execution, token validation, logout, cleanup, protocol, transport, generated output, and dependencies.
rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/runtime-authentication-implementation-boundary.md` and `ADR-0036`; do not add runtime authentication behavior until the relevant gate explicitly authorizes that slice.

rules.title: Application authentication service interface boundary
rules.description: The application authentication service interface boundary must be defined before service code and must preserve application ownership, generated contract vocabulary mapping, redaction expectations, unit-of-work repository usage, request identity handoff, and deferred runtime behavior.
rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/application-authentication-service-interface-boundary.md` and `ADR-0039`; do not add application authentication service code, token generation, verifier comparison, login execution, token validation, logout execution, Protobuf messages, WebSocket proof carriers, authentication dependencies, repository changes, or migration changes until a later bounded work item authorizes that exact slice.

rules.title: Token and credential verifier algorithm redaction boundary
rules.description: The token and credential verifier algorithm redaction boundary must define verifier algorithm posture, digest classification, entropy, encoding, key identifier handling, constant-time comparison expectations, dependency posture, and redaction tests before verifier code exists.
rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/token-credential-verifier-algorithm-redaction-boundary.md` and `ADR-0040`; do not add secret loading, token generation, credential generation, verifier comparison, login execution, token validation, logout execution, Protobuf messages, WebSocket proof carriers, authentication dependencies, repository changes, or migration changes until a later bounded work item authorizes that exact slice.

rules.title: Secret configuration and verifier key loading boundary
rules.description: The secret configuration and verifier key loading boundary must define future key loading ownership, first local key source posture, logical key separation, key identifier redaction, rotation expectations, development/test posture, fail-closed production behavior, and external secret-manager deferral before key loading code exists.
rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/secret-configuration-verifier-key-loading-boundary.md` and `ADR-0041`; do not add secret loading, environment parsing, token generation, credential generation, verifier comparison, login execution, token validation, logout execution, Protobuf messages, WebSocket proof carriers, authentication dependencies, repository changes, migration changes, KMS integration, secret-manager integration, or production authentication behavior until a later bounded work item authorizes that exact slice.

rules.title: Token and credential material generation boundary
rules.description: The token and credential material generation boundary must define future raw material ownership, entropy, URL-safe text presentation, one-time client visibility, raw material non-storage, repository handoff, redaction, dependency posture, and tests before generation code exists.
rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/token-credential-material-generation-boundary.md` and `ADR-0042`; do not add token generation, credential generation, secret loading, verifier digest computation, verifier comparison, login execution, token validation, logout execution, Protobuf messages, WebSocket proof carriers, authentication dependencies, repository changes, migration changes, or production authentication behavior until a later bounded work item authorizes that exact slice.

rules.title: Verifier digest computation and comparison boundary
rules.description: The verifier digest computation and comparison boundary must define future digest helper ownership, canonical input framing, purpose-label and logical-key use, key-set selection, lookup digest handoff, constant-time comparison, public failure collapse, redaction, dependency posture, and tests before digest code exists.
rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/verifier-digest-computation-comparison-boundary.md` and `ADR-0043`; do not add verifier digest computation, verifier comparison, token generation, credential generation, secret loading, login execution, token validation, logout execution, Protobuf messages, WebSocket proof carriers, authentication dependencies, repository changes, migration changes, or production authentication behavior until a later bounded work item authorizes that exact slice.

rules.title: Authentication service implementation readiness gate
rules.description: The authentication service implementation readiness gate must define required prior boundaries, package ownership, first-slice write boundaries, sequencing, tests, redaction, Nakama/Pitaya mapping, and deferrals before authentication service code exists.
rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/authentication-service-implementation-readiness-gate.md` and `ADR-0044`; do not add authentication service code, secret loading, token generation, credential generation, verifier digest computation, verifier comparison, login execution, token validation, logout execution, Protobuf messages, WebSocket proof carriers, authentication dependencies, repository changes, migration changes, or production authentication behavior until a later bounded work item authorizes that exact slice.

rules.title: Local verifier key configuration loading gate
rules.description: The local verifier key configuration loading gate must define the first explicit in-memory verifier key set validation slice, package ownership, file boundaries, validation rules, redaction rules, tests, dependency posture, and deferrals before key loading code exists.
rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/local-verifier-key-configuration-loading-gate.md` and `ADR-0045`; do not parse process environment variables, read local secret files, wire startup, integrate KMS or cloud secret managers, generate tokens or credentials, compute digests, compare verifiers, implement authentication service behavior, expose protocol carriers, change repositories, change migrations, add authentication dependencies, or add production authentication behavior until a later bounded work item authorizes that exact slice.

rules.title: Environment verifier key loader gate
rules.description: The environment verifier key loader gate must define process environment variable names, decoding posture, validation handoff, redaction rules, tests, package ownership, file boundaries, and deferrals before environment loader code exists.
rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/environment-verifier-key-loader-gate.md` and `ADR-0046`; do not parse process environment variables, decode Base64 key text, wire startup, read local secret files, parse dotenv files, accept CLI secret input, integrate KMS or cloud secret managers, generate tokens or credentials, compute digests, compare verifiers, implement authentication service behavior, expose protocol carriers, change repositories, change migrations, add authentication dependencies, or add production authentication behavior until a later bounded work item authorizes that exact slice.

rules.title: Token and credential material generation implementation gate
rules.description: The token and credential material generation implementation gate must define future helper ownership, file boundaries, entropy source handoff, encoding posture, redaction rules, tests, dependency posture, and deferrals before material generation code exists.
rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/token-credential-material-generation-implementation-gate.md` and `ADR-0047`; do not implement token or credential material generation outside the authorized future helper files, and do not compute digests, compare verifiers, implement authentication service behavior, expose protocol carriers, change repositories, change migrations, wire startup, add authentication dependencies, or add production authentication behavior until a later bounded work item authorizes that exact slice.

rules.title: Verifier digest helper implementation gate
rules.description: The verifier digest helper implementation gate must define future helper ownership, file boundaries, canonical input construction, verifier key handoff, digest class mapping, redaction rules, tests, dependency posture, and deferrals before digest computation code exists.
rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/verifier-digest-helper-implementation-gate.md` and `ADR-0048`; do not implement verifier digest computation outside the authorized future helper files, and do not compare verifiers, implement authentication service behavior, expose protocol carriers, change repositories, change migrations, wire startup, add authentication dependencies, or add production authentication behavior until a later bounded work item authorizes that exact slice.

rules.title: Verifier digest comparison helper gate
rules.description: The verifier digest comparison helper gate and implementation check must preserve helper ownership, file boundaries, constant-time primitive posture, input redaction, failure posture, tests, dependency posture, and service/protocol/repository deferrals.
rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/verifier-digest-comparison-helper-gate.md` and `ADR-0049`; keep verifier digest comparison inside the authorized helper files, compare only computed verifier digest bytes with stored verifier digest bytes, use `crypto/hmac.Equal`, and do not implement authentication service behavior, expose protocol carriers, change repositories, change migrations, wire startup, add authentication dependencies, or add production authentication behavior until a later bounded work item authorizes that exact slice.

rules.title: Authentication service behavior implementation gate
rules.description: The authentication service behavior implementation gate and skeleton check must preserve service ownership, file boundaries, repository handoff, helper composition flow, public error collapse, redaction rules, tests, and login/protocol/repository/startup deferrals.
rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/authentication-service-behavior-implementation-gate.md` and `ADR-0050`; keep the skeleton service under `runtime/internal/app/authentication`, use `authentication.Repository` only through the application unit-of-work boundary after a later behavior work item authorizes it, collapse public proof failures, and do not implement login execution, access-token validation execution, protocol carriers, repository changes, migrations, startup wiring, dependencies, or production authentication behavior until a later bounded work item authorizes that exact slice.

rules.title: Device credential login service behavior gate
rules.description: The device credential login service behavior gate must define proof shape, service ownership, dependency shape, helper ordering, repository handoff, token issuance posture, public error collapse, redaction, tests, and deferrals before login execution code exists.
rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/device-credential-login-service-behavior-gate.md` and `ADR-0051`; do not implement device credential login, access-token validation, protocol carriers, startup wiring, repository changes, migrations, generated files, dependencies, or broader production authentication behavior until a later bounded work item authorizes that exact slice.

rules.title: Device credential login service behavior implementation
rules.description: The device credential login service behavior implementation must execute the ADR-0051 service-local sequence while preserving protocol, startup, repository-interface, migration, dependency, generated-file, validation, logout, refresh, cleanup, and production behavior deferrals.
rules.agent_guidance: Keep `AuthenticateWithDeviceCredential` inside `runtime/internal/app/authentication/service.go`; require Base64URL unpadded 32-byte proof pre-validation before unit-of-work, use unit-of-work repository capabilities, compare credential verifiers before token generation, require active player accounts, store token digests only, return raw access-token text only after unit-of-work success, and do not add protocol carriers, startup wiring, repository interface changes, migrations, generated files, external dependencies, access-token validation, logout, refresh, cleanup, or broader production authentication behavior.

rules.title: Access token validation service behavior gate
rules.description: The access token validation service behavior gate must define proof shape, service ownership, dependency reuse, helper ordering, repository handoff, token lifecycle checks, request identity handoff, public error collapse, redaction, tests, and deferrals before validation execution code exists.
rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/access-token-validation-service-behavior-gate.md` and `ADR-0052`; do not implement access-token validation, WebSocket proof carriers, handshake authentication, route protection, session persistence, startup wiring, repository changes, migrations, generated files, dependencies, or broader production authentication behavior until a later bounded work item authorizes that exact slice.

rules.title: Access token validation service behavior implementation
rules.description: The access token validation service behavior implementation must execute the ADR-0052 service-local sequence while preserving protocol, route-protection, session-persistence, startup, repository-interface, migration, dependency, generated-file, logout, refresh, cleanup, and production behavior deferrals.
rules.agent_guidance: Keep `ValidateAccessToken` inside `runtime/internal/app/authentication/service.go`; require Base64URL unpadded 32-byte proof pre-validation before unit-of-work, use unit-of-work repository capabilities, check token lifecycle and audience posture, compare token verifiers before request identity, require active player accounts, keep SessionValidated false, collapse public invalid-token failures, and do not add protocol carriers, route protection, session persistence, startup wiring, repository interface changes, migrations, generated files, external dependencies, logout, refresh, cleanup, or broader production authentication behavior.

rules.title: Access token protocol carrier and route protection gate
rules.description: The access token protocol carrier and route protection gate must define the selected request-level proof carrier posture, route policy boundary, validation handoff, error mapping, redaction, tests, reference mapping, and implementation deferrals before protocol carrier or route protection code exists.
rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/access-token-protocol-carrier-route-protection-gate.md` and `ADR-0053`; keep WebSocket transport credential-neutral, keep the existing Protobuf envelope unchanged, use the future `vibit.authentication.v1.AuthenticatedRequest` payload-wrapper posture only after a bounded implementation work item authorizes `.proto` sources and generated output, and do not add WebSocket handshake authentication, session persistence, startup wiring, repository changes, migrations, dependencies, logout, refresh, cleanup, or broader production authentication behavior from the gate.

rules.title: Runtime authentication startup composition gate
rules.description: The runtime authentication startup composition gate must keep startup wiring in the process composition boundary, wire only existing authentication service and route-protection behavior, preserve WebSocket transport neutrality, and keep session persistence, WebSocket handshake authentication, repository changes, migrations, dependencies, logout, refresh, cleanup, token rotation, and broader behavior deferred.
rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/runtime-authentication-startup-composition-gate.md` and `ADR-0054`; wire authentication startup composition only in `runtime/cmd/vibit-server`, use the existing environment verifier key loader and service dependencies, limit the first composed path to `VIBIT_RUNTIME_STORE=postgres`, preserve memory bootstrap behavior, and do not add handshake authentication, session persistence, repository/migration changes, dependencies, logout, refresh, cleanup, token rotation, or direct Nakama/Pitaya API compatibility.

rules.title: Authentication command protocol login route gate
rules.description: The authentication command protocol login route gate must expose only the explicit public device credential login command route through Protobuf payloads, generated output, protocol bridge behavior, application bootstrap registration, PostgreSQL startup composition, and transaction-wrapper bypass while preserving WebSocket transport neutrality and deferrals.
rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/authentication-command-protocol-login-route-gate.md` and `ADR-0055`; expose only `runtime.authentication.AuthenticateWithDeviceCredential` through the existing WebSocket Protobuf request loop, keep the existing envelope unchanged, keep WebSocket transport credential-neutral, register the route only when the authentication service is composed, bypass the outer transaction wrapper for the login route, and do not add session persistence, WebSocket handshake authentication, repository/migration changes, dependencies, logout, refresh, cleanup, token rotation, memory durable authentication behavior, or direct Nakama/Pitaya API compatibility.

rules.title: Session persistence and WebSocket handshake ratification

rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/session-persistence-websocket-handshake-ratification.md` and `ADR-0056`; preserve request-level validation through `vibit.authentication.v1.AuthenticatedRequest`, keep `RequestIdentity.SessionValidated` false until a later session implementation, do not parse Authorization/Bearer/cookie/query/subprotocol carriers in WebSocket transport, do not change the existing envelope, and do not add session tables, repositories, migrations, dependencies, logout, refresh, cleanup, token rotation, reconnect/epoch behavior, active-connection invalidation, memory durable authentication behavior, or direct Nakama/Pitaya API compatibility.

rules.title: First-message connection binding gate
rules.description: The first-message connection binding gate must select a future protocol/application binding route while keeping WebSocket transport credential-neutral, keeping the existing Protobuf envelope unchanged, preserving request-level validation as the current protected-route path, and deferring implementation, generated output, session persistence, logout/revocation, reconnect, and direct Nakama/Pitaya API compatibility.
rules.agent_guidance: Read `docs/first-message-connection-binding-gate.md` and `ADR-0057`; future binding is through the `runtime.authentication.BindConnection` system route with `vibit.authentication.v1.BindConnectionRequest` / `BindConnectionResponse` payload candidates, but this gate does not authorize Protobuf source changes, generated output, connection binding registries, route-policy use of bound identity, session tables, repositories, migrations, dependencies, logout/revocation, reconnect/epoch behavior, transport credential carriers, memory durable authentication behavior, or direct Nakama/Pitaya API compatibility.

rules.title: Generated artifact created
rules.description: A generator created a repository artifact.
rules.agent_guidance: Review the created artifact and update manifests or docs if needed.

rules.title: Generated artifact already exists
rules.description: A generator found an existing artifact and left it in place.
rules.agent_guidance: Inspect the existing artifact before assuming it matches the current generator template.

rules.title: Generic check message
rules.description: A check result did not match a more specific rule pattern.
rules.agent_guidance: Read the result message and consider adding a more specific rule if this becomes common.

rules.title: Subcheck spawn
rules.description: An aggregate check could not run a subcheck process.
rules.agent_guidance: Inspect the runtime error and verify the CLI can run the subcheck directly.

rules.title: Subcheck JSON parse
rules.description: An aggregate check expected JSON from a subcheck but could not parse it.
rules.agent_guidance: Run the subcheck directly with `--json` and fix invalid output or stderr pollution.

rules.title: Aggregate subcheck
rules.description: An aggregate check summarized the status of a subcheck.
rules.agent_guidance: If this result failed, run the referenced subcheck directly with `--json` for details.
